title: Safe COTP CR followed by Cancel-Request-PDU
purpose: Exercise the remotely reachable connection-establishment parser path implicated by the TPDU-size option issue and then transition into MMS PDU tag coverage for Cancel-Request-PDU with a distinct two-message stateful sequence.

messages.label: COTP Connection Request with bounded TPDU-size code

expected_behavior: The CR should parse without undefined behavior because the TPDU-size option remains length 1 but uses a bounded code instead of the historical out-of-range exponent. The subsequent MMS Cancel-Request-PDU should be accepted as a distinct parser entry point or rejected cleanly at a higher semantic layer without transport-parser instability.
constraints_preserved: TPKT total-length fields are consistent with the complete message.
COTP TPDU-size parameter retains the documented 0xc0 0x01 structure but avoids the exact crashing value from issue 589.
Sequence diversifies connection setup and cancel operation coverage.
No exact historical payload collision is reused.
issue_safety_notes: Safe structural analogue only: preserves the vulnerable option path shape c0 01 xx while replacing the dangerous exponent byte a2 with bounded value 0a. No negative-size or oversized-allocation motifs are included.
